name: 28580 · Snow Hill, NC
findings: ZIP 28580 (Snow Hill) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28580 (Snow Hill) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28580 (Snow Hill) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
